scope_summary.value: Electrical engineering design for two diesel backup generators: a 500kW unit serving the main building and storage building (served by a 500kVA transformer and 3,000A main distribution panel), and a 150kW unit serving the administration building (served by a 112.5kVA transformer and 400A main distribution panel). Each generator includes a diesel sub-base tank for 72-hour runtime, automatic transfer switch, concrete equipment pad, galvanized steel maintenance platform with stairs and railings, and BAS tie-in. Underground electrical ductbank and conduit runs connect the generators to the existing electrical service infrastructure.
scope_summary.quote: The project includes providing electrical engineering design services for the addition of two back up generators. Generator 1 will serve the main building and storage building. Generator 2 will serve the administration building. Both generators will be sized for total building service.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Both values retained. $750,000 is the owner's stated NTE budget; $1,029,334 is the A/E's cost estimate at 100% design. These are not the same thing.
conflict_flags.rationale: The NTE budget was set at $750,000 in the RFP (July 2022). The 100%-design estimate came in at $1,029,334 (November 2022), exceeding budget by approximately $279,334 (~37%). This is a significant budget overrun finding. The BOD cost estimate acknowledges '$750,000 construction funds available' as a reference point. Resolution of this overrun (scope reduction, VE, additional funding) is not documented in available sources. This conflict is material to past-performance framing.

conflict_flags.rationale: The RFP was written at an early stage before detailed investigation. The BOD reflects actual site conditions at 100% design. 'Museum' in the RFP may refer to a function within the administration building, or may reflect an early understanding of the facility's program. The paint shop referenced in the RFP is likely part of the main building complex. Minor discrepancy; BOD is authoritative for construction scope.
